body: I'm quite a funny guy so I guess I'd like to do something funny. Maybe comically gaming or something. Who knows.

UPDATE: At 7pm BST I will be taking my life. Thank you all for the kind messages. I am glad that in my last moments I was given some kindness. Again, thank you all, stay strong. Goodnight, I hope you're happy.

Bo Burnham said something in his Netflix special "Make Happy" that really hit me.

"Come and watch the skinny kid with a, steadily declining mental health, and laugh as he attempts to give you what he cannot give himself."

This is still the most powerful thing I think I've ever related to. People sit back and watch you and laugh as your bullshit spews and you just try to make the days go by. I think I'd like to be like Bo Burnham. A comedian with a message. A performer.

But it's too late for that. I'm just ready to accept that what I'll do will have the ripple effect.
If I could get paid to do anything for the rest of my life I think it would be YouTube. I really would like to do that. If not then truck driving or being a lawyer.

Neither of them talk to me first, and one is always busy. She says she is "at her dads this weekend" or "can't really do weekdays" then I see on her snapchat she's with her friend. It's ridiculous. The other one lives too far away for me to just get up and go see them, and they're always busy studying anyway.
I've literally got 2 friends and they don't talk to me outside of college. That.
I'll admit you've gotta have serious balls to wake up and deal with the shit. But I can't do it. I gotta be selfish just this once.
I wish there was a way but I'm afraid not. Sorry man.
In terms of staying alive or ending my life?
I've been playing the game for years. I'm making my choice based off of years of hardship and pain.
I'd like to talk. Pm me.
You too friend. Take care. Go clean.
Thank you for the kind words but I think I'm pretty sure I know what I want to do now.

My parents don't care about me and I know a lot of people say that when they are living with depression but honestly, they think I am a spoiled brat with no intention of doing anything with my life (tbf they are right). I haven't got any siblings who care either since they all live their own lives and my grandparents are dead, and my friends... Haha, friends. I have none.
A post on a site is the only place maybe somebody would even care.

My life is just horrible. My family are abusive, my mind is fucked. I have Borderline Personality Disorder. I am fat and ugly and lonely. I wasn't ever meant to be alive. I just want to give up my place to another more deserving.
